# parquet-tools

> Inspect, validate and convert Parquet files: schema, row groups and column statistics, expected-schema checks with nullability, and bounded conversion to and from CSV or JSONL Python package `trysac-parquet-tools`, import name `parquet_tools`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
